# markdown-it 14.1.0

Unmodified `dist/markdown-it.min.js` and MIT license from the npm package
`markdown-it@14.1.0` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/markdown-it/v/14.1.0).
Vendored so the expert workbench does not depend on a public CDN at runtime.
Raw HTML is disabled; the application only renders images from the selected run.
